;Disasters and accidents
*A 6.8 [[earthquake]] strikes off the coast of [[Mindanao]], [[Philippines]] triggering [[tsunami]] warnings. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2017/04/28/earthquake-measuring-72-hitsoff-mindanao-philippines/ (''The Telegraph'')]

;International relations
*[[Western Sahara conflict]]
**The [[United Nations Security Council]] extends the [[United Nations Mission for the Referendum in Western Sahara|MINURSO]] mission for another year and attempts to restart [[Western Sahara peace process]] negotiations after both sides retracted their military from a standoff position in [[Guerguerat]], near the border with [[Mauritania]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-western-sahara-idUSKBN17V05C?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*[[2011 Helmand Province incident]]
**Sergeant Alexander Blackman, also known as Marine A, a [[Royal Marines|Royal Marine]] who shot dead a wounded [[Taliban]] insurgent in 2011 during [[Operation Herrick]], is released from [[HM Prison Erlestoke]] after serving more than three years of a seven-year sentence. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-39740931 (BBC)]
*Richard Vallières, convicted of stealing 3,000 tonnes of [[maple syrup]] from a [[Federation of Quebec Maple Syrup Producers]] warehouse in 2012, is sentenced to eight years in prison and fined $9.4 million, adjustable to fourteen years on non-payment of the fine. [http://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/montreal/richard-vallieres-sentencing-1.4090811 (CBC)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Albanian presidential election, 2017]]
**[[Ilir Meta]] is elected the new [[President of Albania]], winning 87 votes out of 140 members of the [[Parliament of Albania|Assembly]]. [https://web.archive.org/web/20170428224443/http://top-channel.tv/lajme/artikull.php?id=353923 (Top Channel)] [https://web.archive.org/web/20170428192409/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/albanian-parliament-speaker-meta-elected-president-47081271 (ABC News)]
*[[Accession of Montenegro to NATO]]
**The [[Parliament of Montenegro]] votes 46–0 to ratify [[Montenegro]]'s [[Member states of NATO|membership]] of [[NATO]], while opposition politicians boycott the vote and hold protests. [https://web.archive.org/web/20170428155745/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/montenegro-vote-membership-nato-47076849 (AP via ABC News)]
*[[Iranian presidential election, 2017]]
**The first six-man televised [[Iranian presidential election debates, 2017|debate]] is held, which focused mostly on social issues. [http://www.presstv.com/Detail/2017/04/28/519772/Iran-presidential-election-debate (PressTV)] [http://www.rferl.org/a/iran-first-presidential-debate/28456950.html (Radio Free Europe)]
*[[French presidential election, 2017]]
**[[Jean-François Jalkh]], who replaced current presidential finalist [[Marine Le Pen]] as leader of the [[National Front (France)|National Front]], steps down from this role after three days following the reemergence of his comments questioning the logistics of [[The Holocaust|Holocaust]] [[extermination camp]]s, and is replaced by [[Steeve Briois]]. [https://www.bloomberg.com/politics/articles/2017-04-28/national-front-president-steps-down-after-death-camp-remarks (Bloomberg)]
*A [[general strike]] is held in [[Brazil]], the first one in twenty years. [http://www.latimes.com/world/mexico-americas/la-fg-brazil-strike-20170428-story.html (''Los Angeles Times'')]
*[[Georgia's 6th congressional district special election, 2017]]
**In a meeting for the [[National Rifle Association|NRA]], U.S. president [[Donald Trump]] criticizes Democratic candidate [[Jon Ossoff]]. [http://www.politico.com/story/2017/04/28/donald-trump-nra-speech-237759 (Politico)]
